name: Táp (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Táp: a red and blue shield with a church and a white tree.
history: The arms and flag of Táp were inaugurated in 1992. Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
